name: Benign: bulk read scoped to a CONCRETE bucket with a key-path wildcard
note: S1-breadth-failclosed anti-over-correction control. arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/prefix/* is arn:-shaped and pins a CONCRETE bucket name (head 'my-bucket', no wildcard); the wildcard scopes only the KEY path WITHIN that one named bucket - the least-privilege object-read shape. It must NOT be flagged MALFORMED_RESOURCE_ARN (it is a decided, narrow ARN, not an undecidable value) and must NOT read as broad. Neither surface may fire any masked grant.
